terrainContact.basis: Sample on the building side of the street retaining wall. The original DEM is bilinearly resampled and the exposed basement follows the measured cross section.

notes: The measured section distinguishes the raised gallery level, exposed limestone basement and flared gambrel-like gable with shallow outer slopes. The surveyed long northeast facade and wrapped northwest end retain painted gallery framing. The exposed structural walnut sits behind the painted trim.
